toast.title: SECRET FOUND!
toast.offList: This one was not on the list.

welcome.name: Welcome
welcome.hint: Open the SECRETS list. Done. That is how every chart starts.

topAtTop.name: Nowhere To Go
topAtTop.hint: Press the Top button when you're already at the top. Or Bottom at the bottom.

copyright.name: Fine Print
copyright.hint: Open the long copyright list in the footer and scroll all the way to the end.

typeLogin.name: Login Loop
typeLogin.hint: Click the "Please log in again." text on HOME, or type login on your keyboard. Then keep logging in until it sticks.

friendNobody.name: Nobody
friendNobody.hint: On SEARCH FRIENDS, search for the code 0000000000000.

invertedDark.name: Blindfold Mode
invertedDark.hint: Buy the fake Premium Course in SHOP and switch on its one real perk, dark mode.

aprilFoolsBypass.name: Free Rider
aprilFoolsBypass.hint: Ignore the orange Subscribe button on any blurred paywall and tap the tiny line underneath it.

grandTour.name: Arcade Sightseeing
grandTour.hint: Visit all eight colorful menu tiles across the top at least once.

logo.name: Loose Logo
logo.hint: The big logo at the top is not glued on well. Tap it like a stream of TAP notes.

gear.name: TOUCH HOLD
gear.hint: Don't tap the gear button. Hold it. Like a touch hold.

slide.name: SLIDE!
slide.hint: Every maimai player knows this move. Draw a big circle on the page with your mouse or finger.

ferris.name: Ride Operator
ferris.hint: The Ferris wheel in the footer town still works. Click it a few times.

phpWarning.name: Bug Fixer
phpWarning.hint: That warning on HOME looks fixable. Click it until it is.

aiPoke.name: Poke
aiPoke.hint: tomomai AI on your friend list hates being poked. Poke it anyway.

typeAime.name: Touch Your Card
typeAime.hint: tomomai AI says touch it harder. Press the Aime note on FRIENDS, or type aime, then slam the reader.

optionsMute.name: Silent Play
optionsMute.hint: In Options, turn every sound off and save.

favoritesSpam.name: Superfan
favoritesSpam.hint: Favorites are Premium. Ask on a song page anyway. Keep asking.

friendSelf.name: Narcissist
friendSelf.hint: Your own FRIEND CODE is on SEARCH FRIENDS. Search for it, then add whoever turns up.

notFound.name: Lost
notFound.hint: Follow the unavailable OLDER RECORDS link on HOME, or visit a NET address that does not exist.

circleEscape.name: Button 3 Pact
circleEscape.hint: Try to walk out on your Circle. Keep pressing the leave button until they lock the door.

logoutSpam.name: Hotel California
logoutSpam.hint: Press LOG OUT in OPTIONS five times until the site admits you cannot leave.

teapot.name: Short and Stout
teapot.hint: Read the 404 page closely for where tomomai AI looked. Then feed the machine you find a few coins.

stickyButton3.name: Button 3 Strikes Again
stickyButton3.hint: Look closely at the eight cabinet buttons on the teapot. One is the wrong color for a reason.

friendError.name: Familiar Face
friendError.hint: Search for the six-digit error code that haunts the footer, the login loop and your Circle.

shopCancelFree.name: Cancel Nothing
shopCancelFree.hint: Try to cancel the course that costs nothing.

nudgeDecline.name: Hard to Get
nudgeDecline.hint: Say no to Premium. Then again. Then once more, another day.

danRetry.name: One More Try
danRetry.hint: Keep feeding credits into the impossible banquet course on DAN. Survive it and it hands you a word.

konami.name: Wrong Company
konami.hint: A famous cheat code from another arcade publisher still works here. It also shouts a word at you.

console.name: Job Applicant
console.hint: Developers have a secret panel in the browser. On a phone, someone in the footer is hiring.

tabAway.name: Come Back
tabAway.hint: Leave for a bit. The cabinet will notice.

idle.name: Attract Mode
idle.hint: Hands off the controls for a full minute. Bored cabinets love showing off to an empty arcade.

optionsMaxed.name: Speed Demon
optionsMaxed.hint: Turn every option all the way up and save.

optionsSpin.name: Spin Cycle
optionsSpin.hint: Turn the cabinet into a front-load washing machine in OPTIONS, with the goofiest hit sound.

titlePersistent.name: Persistent
titlePersistent.hint: Try very hard to set a title you don't own.

friendMirror.name: Mirror Mode
friendMirror.hint: You, flipped end to end like a mirrored chart. Your FRIEND CODE is on SEARCH FRIENDS.

serialUtage.name: Banquet Ticket
serialUtage.hint: Survive the banquet or break the publisher's rules, then bring the word they shout to SERIAL CODE.

admin.name: Staff Only
admin.hint: Every arcade has a door for staff. Button 3 knows where it is, and the password is easy.

credits.name: Roll Credits
credits.hint: Fight the unkillable error behind the staff door until the closing roll starts, then stay past the last line.

doubleSlide.name: EX Spin Slide
doubleSlide.hint: One circle is ADVANCED. Keep spinning without lifting your hand until the cabinet gets dizzy.

buttonSpin.name: Full Ring
buttonSpin.hint: Hit all eight cabinet buttons in one clean clockwise sweep.

printReceipt.name: Paper Trail
printReceipt.hint: Ask your browser for a paper copy of your credit.

fakeUrgency.name: Limited Time Only
fakeUrgency.hint: Call the Premium popup's bluff and watch its urgent countdown run all the way out.

everyTab.name: Full Sightread
everyTab.hint: Sightread every regular page on the whole site without missing a single sub-tab.

maintenance.name: Night Owl
maintenance.hint: DX NET sleeps. We don't. Visit while it's asleep.

aprilFools.name: Right On Time
aprilFools.hint: Visit on the one day this site makes sense.

page.title: Secrets
page.intro: tomomai NET hides {total} secrets. Some are easy. Some are MASTER. Found ones are saved in this browser only.
page.introAccent: No guessing required. Every secret has a hint below.
page.complete: ALL PERFECT+. Every secret, found. Please log in again to celebrate.
page.resetConfirm: Really forget all {count, plural, one {# secret} other {# secrets}}?
page.note: Secrets live in this browser. A new browser means a fresh hunt, like a new Aime card.

verdicts.D: D. Even the stranger behind you has found more.
verdicts.C: C. Halfway. maimai would call that a fail.
verdicts.B: B. You are poking around. tomomai AI is watching.
verdicts.BB: BB. The cabinet has started to notice you.
verdicts.BBB: BBB. Your Aime card is sweating.
verdicts.A: A. Getting warm. Do not get cocky.
verdicts.AA: AA. You are clearly avoiding playing real maimai.
verdicts.AAA: AAA. Your friends are worried about you.
verdicts.S: S. One more credit. Then one more secret.
verdicts.SS: SS. SEGA has been notified. They do not care.
verdicts.SSS: SSS. So close you can taste the 101%.
verdicts.SSS+: SSS+. tomomai AI is impressed. Do not tell it we said that.

page.offChartNote: Secrets that were never on the list. You found these on your own.

hasunosora.name: Lotus Sky
hasunosora.hint: Watered the lotus in the corner of the footer, and the whole pond answered.

gakumas.name: Hatsuboshi Producer
gakumas.hint: Kept poking a first star until a first-year idol turned up. Then you scouted her.
